summary: Registry schema toolchain-workflow-repair.command-registry.v1; 20 noninteractive Python commands; green and terminal lanes w0-w6 run seven focused pytest modules, with w6 E2E timeout 600s and others 300s; aggregate skill-input-suite runs consumption tests; knowledge-suite runs knowledge-gate tests; workflow-repair-e2e repeats E2E; plan-ready invokes validate_plan_ready.py against repository root and dated plan directory; terminal-full invokes terminal_full.py for same plan with 1800s timeout; all commands use repo-relative cwd, shell disabled, Python 3 -B; coverage includes selection, transport, coverage, knowledge gate, generation pointer, retention, consumption, and workflow repair; no explicit ambiguity or failure disposition
